blocks.text: Fifteen years in the hospitality industry is a milestone worth celebrating, but for Crimson Hotels & Resorts, the occasion was also an opportunity to look back at the people, partnerships, and stories that made the journey possible. This was the heart of Rendezvous by Crimson, an evening that brought together valued partners, industry leaders, former employees, and members of the Crimson community to celebrate the brand’s 15th anniversary. More than a gathering to mark another year, the celebration served as a tribute to the relationships that have helped shape Crimson into a Filipino-bred name in the hospitality industry.
